title: Nondeterministic program semantics
statement: For a nondeterministic register program $A$, an oracle, an input $x$, a guard $G$ on configurations, an initial configuration $a$, and a proposition $P$, define the semantics to mean that $A$ terminates from $a$ under guard $G$ and that $a$ is accepting if and only if $P$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: Program $A$ is a nondeterministic register program
An input bit string $x$ is specified
A guard $G$ on configurations is specified
